# FIVESOM

> FIVESOM is a freelancer marketplace built for the Somali market, connecting skilled freelancers with buyers through a secure escrow system and locally-friendly USSD payments.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of FIVESOM and featured services.
- [Explore](/explore): Browse active gigs from verified freelancers.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide for buyers and freelancers.
- [Docs](/docs): Full A-Z documentation in English, Somali, Arabic, and French.
- [VIP](/vip): VIP / featured seller program.
- [Register as Buyer](/register/buyer): Sign up to hire freelancers.
- [Register as Freelancer](/register/freelancer): Sign up to sell services.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Existing user sign-in.
